name: Enjouji Reika
source:
Known by the nickname "Her Majesty, the Queen", Reika is the former Student Council President and is very popular among the other students. She has been friends with [url=/c98390]Mitsuru[/url] since they were children. Reika's family is very wealthy and influential. Reika is very attached to her brothers and tends to get irritated when they're gone for long periods of time.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
